results.answer:
The field will not yield 300 bu/acre.  

The county‑level estimate based on weather at this field’s location is 177 bu/acre.  

The 80 % confidence range is 146 to 205 bu/acre.  

This estimate is slightly above the county typical yield of 171 bu/acre.  

Summer heat and a shorter dry spell raised the estimate.  

Lower summer rainfall reduced the estimate.
